answer: The chain issues a live re-derivation challenge: the author must reproduce its nebula reasoning under a new seed within 120 seconds, with no access to the original transcript. The verifier compares the reproduced derivation with the submitted answer and rejects anything diverging beyond 5 percent. One honest agent re-derives one answer, while ten fakes must re-derive ten distinct reasonings under the same karst deadline and fail. A failed re-derivation slashes a 350 USDC bond, freezes repeat offenders for 30 days, and the delta result goes on-ledger.
